findings.reason: the node should keep a dispatch-level refusal case on a lane that stays undeclared (the claude lane) beside the new naming case, otherwise §14 retires a landed section's evidence and its own sentence "a backend that declares no image input still refuses … by name, as today" goes unmeasured on the caller it is about.
findings.text: §14's done-when requires that "the tests that asserted the clive refusal (in tests/test_dispatch_attaches_the_figures.py …) now give that backend a declaration and assert the named path", but `test_a_clive_lane_refuses_the_figures_and_names_the_lane` (tests/test_dispatch_attaches_the_figures.py:342, dispatched with `backend_override="clive"` against the file's fixture config) is the dispatch-level evidence §6 names for its own landed done-when ("the same node on a clive backend is refused with the lane named"), and it is one of the five tests c-close-s6 cites; converting it to a naming assertion leaves the dispatch path with no refusal case at all, so a change that made an undeclared lane name its images instead of refusing would be caught only at the `launch_plan` layer

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — resolved in the tree: `_refuse_images` (reckon/_backends.py:1071) reached from `_ClaudeDialect.argv` (:1594), `_CliveDialect(_ClaudeDialect)` (:2006), `stdin_prompt = True` on the prompt contract (:1044) with `stdin_text=prompt` (:2267), `_backend_settings` (reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:910) called in `resume_plan` (:1255) with the run's figures at the launch (:1353), all four named test files and `test_a_lane_that_cannot_carry_the_figure_refuses_by_name` (tests/test_launch_plan_attaches_images.py:105), and the cited evidence anchor `#s13-the-local-lane-receives-an-opened-image` in docs/evidence/archive/a-review-can-see-the-figure-landed.html:120.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §14's done-when directs the conversion of the only dispatch-level refusal test, so the undeclared-lane refusal loses its dispatch-path coverage while §6 stays declared `done`.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — every log in §14 sits under the run directory, the declaration lands in the committed `docs/state/reckon/flight.yaml`, and no evidence path is a scratchpad or node-local temp.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new file `tests/test_a_local_worker_is_named_its_images.py` is named by mechanism, and §14 carries no plan label, ticket number or version tag into a symbol or comment.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the three checks hold on the real code path: the fresh path hands `launch_plan` the resolved lane mapping that carries `input_modalities` (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2432) and the resume path rebuilds that mapping through `_backend_settings`, which as written merges only `usable_input_window`, `model` and `effort` from the configured lane (dispatch_sessions.py:965-975) and so does drop `input_modalities` — the stated defect reproduces and the named fix is the one the function's own `setdefault` merge already uses; the layer merge is `deep_merge`, so a project-layer `input_modalities` on clive is not shadowed by the host layer's clive block (which declares none), and the declaration therefore reaches production rather than only the empty-host-layer test; and keying on the lane's declaration rather than the dialect is what keeps the claude lane refusing, since `_ClaudeDialect.argv` still calls `_refuse_images` for any backend that declares nothing.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — one capability (the local lane is handed a figure on each launch path and declares it); the launch_plan branch is the mechanism and the `_backend_settings` carry is its resume half.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — `plan-section-depends-on` records s14 → a-review-can-see-the-figure#s13, which is `done`, and the siblings §14 relies on (§6 dispatch path, §10 render, §12 lane selection) are landed and unchanged, with the cross-plan relationship carried by `plan-informs`.
